description: This file defines an authentication store using Zustand in a React application, handling user sign-in with Google, redirect handling, and sign-out logic.

methods.name: signInWithGoogle
methods.description: Initiates Google sign-in via redirect, either using a mock or real SDK, and handles redirect post-authentication.

methods.name: handleRedirect
methods.description: Completes the redirect sign-in process by retrieving and setting the mock token from URL parameters.

methods.name: signOut
methods.description: Resets authentication state and clears related local storage items.
